x.description: (..., M, N) array_like Input array having shape (..., M, N) and whose last two dimensions form matrices on which to perform singular value decomposition. Should have a floating-point data type.
constraints: Should have a floating-point data type.

output.description: ------- ndarray An array with shape (..., K) that contains the vector(s) of singular values of length K, where K = min(M, N).
